rounds: I could imagine moving to another continent for good.
Freedom of movement is the best thing the EU has done.
Rich countries should pay poorer ones to host refugees for them.
Borders will matter less in fifty years than they do today.
Turning away people in danger is never justified.
In a crisis, I would let a family I didn’t know live in my flat.
By 2050, climate change will force more people to move than war.
Safe legal routes would stop more dangerous sea crossings than border patrols do.
